record.original_question: Construct a strictly convex C^1-smooth billiard table with positive entropy, and also construct a convex C^2-smooth billiard table with positive entropy.

evidence.quote: The only examples of convex billiard tables with positive entropy are the stadium and its generalizations.
Problem 2. a) Construct a strictly convex C^1-smooth billiard table with positive entropy. b) Construct a convex C^2-smooth billiard table with positive entropy.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider planar billiards: given a bounded region $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ whose boundary is a closed convex curve, the billiard map acts on the unit tangent bundle restricted to the boundary by the rule of specular reflection (angle of incidence equals angle of reflection). Known examples of convex billiard tables with positive metric (or topological) entropy include the Bunimovich stadium and its generalizations, whose boundaries are only $C^1$ and fail to be strictly convex (containing straight segments).

Solve the following two construction problems.

(a) Construct a strictly convex billiard table $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ whose boundary is a $C^1$-smooth closed curve and whose billiard map has positive metric entropy with respect to the natural invariant (Liouville) measure.

(b) Construct a convex billiard table $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ whose boundary is a $C^2$-smooth closed curve and whose billiard map has positive metric entropy.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Bessa–Dias Carneiro–Pacífico-style and the 2022 result of Bessa et al., "Billiards in generic convex bodies have positive topological entropy") establishes that a $C^2$-open and dense set of smooth convex bodies have billiard maps with a hyperbolic basic set, hence positive topological entropy. This gives genericity-type answers but not an explicit construction; the problem in its strict-convexity $C^1$ form (a) and explicit $C^2$ form (b) remains widely cited as open. Status is best described as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Billiards in generic convex bodies have positive topological entropy
status_evidence.snippet: There exists a C^2 open dense set of convex bodies with smooth boundary whose billiard map exhibits a non-trivial hyperbolic basic set, and consequently positive topological entropy.
status_evidence.claim: Generic C^2 smooth convex billiards have positive topological entropy, giving a partial (non-constructive) answer to part (b).

status_evidence.title: Billiard dynamics: An updated survey with the emphasis on open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys open problems in billiard dynamics, including the question of strictly convex smooth billiards with positive entropy.
status_evidence.claim: The construction problem is listed among open problems in surveys of billiard dynamics.
